demo.title: team-check.sh
demo.code:
# Who built this Robinhood Chain token? One public call, no key.
curl -s -H "x-hey-integration: bankr-skill/0.1.1" \
  "https://heyresearch.xyz/api/v1/scan?chain=4663&token=0x090980a62d5007f6190b04782d0ea690ab53c210"
# -> "status_label": "Shipping", "verified_builder": true,
#    "token_verification": "VERIFIED" (the project's own site names this contract),
#    "project_url": "https://heyresearch.xyz/project/insula-world"
# Unknown stays unknown: "found": false means no record, never a red flag.

setup: Install this skill in Bankr. No API key, account or wallet: every HEY read is public and free.

Before buying a Robinhood Chain token, adding it to an index basket or pairing a launch with it, the agent checks the team behind it: still shipping or not, last ship with its source, and whether the project's own site names that contract.

Optional: add HEY's hosted MCP under Connections > Custom MCPs (https://heyresearch.xyz/mcp, no authentication) for deeper research in chat. MCP tools are not used on X or Farcaster; the skill's REST call works everywhere.
Evidence about building only: never a buy or sell call, a price view or a safety verdict. Pair it with a contract check such as bankr-token-scam-analysis.
